unchecked.item: Q13 縦の坂
unchecked.source: バリアフリー法施行令の傾斜路 1/12 (= 8.33 %), 第19条, https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/api/1/lawdata/418CO0000000379; read 2026-11-03 in a source check. 製品の定格は 5 度以下 (Pudu BellaBot), https://www.pudurobotics.com/en/products/bellabot (this part not checked in this repository)

unchecked.item: Q17 曲がり
unchecked.source: assumption

unchecked.source: assumption (indoor, 5 to 35 degC; the makers publish no operating temperature)

unchecked.item: Q20 水・ほこり (IP)
unchecked.source: assumption (a sample answer: drinks may splash on a restaurant robot)

unchecked.item: Q21 荷台の固定点 1 か所が受けられる力の下限
unchecked.source: assumption: the smallest row for goods road vehicles borrowed for a much lighter vehicle. EN 12640 as quoted in the European Best Practice Guidelines on Cargo Securing for Road Transport (2014) 2.6, Table 3: vehicle total mass 3.5 to 7.5 t, strength of a lashing point 800 daN (= 8 000 N), read 2026-11-06 (secondary, PDF p. 23); the table has no row below 3.5 t; EN 12640 itself not checked (paid). The CTU Code 6.6.8 says most goods road vehicles have points of LC or MSL 20 kN, read 2026-11-06 (p. 27). No ROV standard or manual read gives a strength for cargo bed anchors

unchecked.item: Q22 電線の電流を確かめるときの周りの温度
unchecked.source: assumption: 40 degC is the ambient air temperature of the automotive current rating table in the Anixter catalogue, page 02•43 "Current Ratings for Automotive Cables" (ambient 40 degC, single cable isolated in free air), https://objects.eanixter.com/PD379251-AN.PDF, read 2026-11-06 (secondary: a distributor's technical page). It is the condition of that table, not a measured temperature of this vehicle: near the motor, the controller, the brakes or in the sun it can be higher, and then the table value is too high

unchecked.item: Q23 束ねて触れ合う電線の、流してよい電流の割合
unchecked.source: Anixter catalogue, page 02•43 "Current Ratings for Automotive Cables", note: wires grouped and touching, rating factor 2 cables 0.80, 3 0.70, 4 0.65, 5 0.60, 6 0.56, 7 0.53, 8 0.50, https://objects.eanixter.com/PD379251-AN.PDF, read 2026-11-06 (secondary: a distributor's technical page for automotive cable; the standard or calculation behind it is not named). 0.50 (8 cables) is taken so that one number covers a harness of up to 8 touching cables; more than 8 cables is not in the table (not checked). Similar factors for other classes, borrowed and not used: 33 CFR 183 Table 5 note 2 (boats, 7-24 conductors 0.50), DIN VDE 0298-4 Table 21 quoted by Lapp Table 12-6 (industrial cables, 8 cables 0.52)

unchecked.item: Q24 回路を守る器具の定格電流の、守る電線の流してよい電流に対する上限の割合
unchecked.source: assumption: borrowed from aircraft and boats. FAA AC 43.13-1B with Change 1, par. 11-48: a circuit breaker is rated so that it opens before the current rating of the wire attached to it is exceeded, read 2026-11-06 (https://www.faa.gov/documentLibrary/media/Advisory_Circular/AC_43.13-1B_w-chg1.pdf; aircraft wiring). 33 CFR 183.455(c), read 2026-11-06 (https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-33/chapter-I/subchapter-S/part-183/subpart-I; boats with gasoline engines): not above 150 % of the Table 5 amperage for circuits under 50 V, not above 100 % for 50 V or more (the next larger standard size allowed if it does not exceed 150 %). The 51.2 V circuit is above 50 V, so 1.0 is taken for every circuit. The road-vehicle rules (ISO 8820, ISO 6469-3:2021 clauses 7.1 and 7.2) were not checked

unchecked.item: Q26 束ねた電線を曲げる内側の半径の下限 (束の中でいちばん太い電線の外径の倍数)
unchecked.source: assumption: borrowed from aircraft wiring. FAA AC 43.13-1B with Change 1, par. 11-96 aa and 11-117: the bend radius of wire groups or bundles not less than 10 times the outside diameter of the largest wire (3 times in 11-96 aa, 6 times in 11-117, where suitably supported at breakouts or reversals), read 2026-11-06, https://www.faa.gov/documentLibrary/media/Advisory_Circular/AC_43.13-1B_w-chg1.pdf. No road-vehicle value for a bundle was read

unchecked.item: Q27 配線を支える点どうしの間隔の上限
unchecked.source: assumption: borrowed from aircraft wiring. FAA AC 43.13-1B with Change 1, par. 11-96 a and 11-146: wires and cables supported at intervals not more than 24 in (= 609.6 mm, computed) unless in troughs, ducts or conduits; 11-118: normally not more than 1/2 in (12.7 mm) deflection between supports, read 2026-11-06, https://www.faa.gov/documentLibrary/media/Advisory_Circular/AC_43.13-1B_w-chg1.pdf. A public road-vehicle spacing (SAE J1292, an OEM harness guide) was not found; this vehicle shakes more on rough tracks than an aircraft in normal flight, so the borrowed value may be too long (not checked)

unchecked.item: Q28 板や縁を通り抜ける所での、配線と縁の隙間の下限 (留められない所)
unchecked.source: assumption: borrowed from aircraft wiring. FAA AC 43.13-1B with Change 1, par. 11-115: protective grommets wherever wires cannot be clamped, so that there is at least 3/8 in (= 9.525 mm, computed) clearance from structure at penetrations, read 2026-11-06, https://www.faa.gov/documentLibrary/media/Advisory_Circular/AC_43.13-1B_w-chg1.pdf. 33 CFR 183.445(a) (boats) asks that a conductor through a bulkhead or other rigid surface is protected from abrasion, with no number, read 2026-11-06 (https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-33/chapter-I/subchapter-S/part-183/subpart-I)

unchecked.item: Q34 弱い人がいるか
unchecked.source: assumption

unchecked.item: Q39 電池の端子から、最初に回路を守る器具までの電線の長さの上限
unchecked.source: assumption: borrowed from boats. 33 CFR 183.460(a): each ungrounded output conductor from a storage battery has a trip-free circuit breaker or fuse within 72 in (= 1828.8 mm, computed) of the battery, measured along the conductor (the cranking motor feed is excepted); 183.455(b) puts the device at the source of power, or within 7 in (177.8 mm), or within 40 in (1016 mm) if the conductor is sheathed, read 2026-11-06, https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-33/chapter-I/subchapter-S/part-183/subpart-I (boats with gasoline engines). The longest of these is taken; a road-vehicle value was not checked

unchecked.item: Q53 止まっていられる坂
unchecked.source: assumption: the robot stays still on the steepest slope it is allowed to drive on, the 1/12 (= 8.33 %) of Q13 (バリアフリー法施行令 第19条, read 2026-11-03 in a source check); that parking uses the same slope is HIRAKU's choice

unchecked.item: Q58 最小回転半径の上限
unchecked.source: assumption: the 12 m of a motor vehicle on a public road and of the design vehicle of a forest road, applied to a vehicle on private land. 道路運送車両の保安基準 第 6 条第 1 項 (最小回転半径は、最外側のわだちについて 12 m 以下), read 2026-11-05 in the e-Gov law text (https://laws.e-gov.go.jp/law/326M50000800067). 林業専用道作設指針 (林野庁長官通知 平成 22 年 9 月 24 日 22林整整第 602 号) 第 3 の 1 (設計車両 普通自動車 最小回転半径 12 m) と 6 (曲線半径は原則 12 m 以上), read 2026-11-05 (https://www.rinya.maff.go.jp/j/seibi/saisei/pdf/rinngyousenyou.pdf). The narrower curves of the 林道規程 (design speed 20 km/h: class 1 15 m, class 2 12 m, class 3 6 m) come from the 森林総合研究所 Q&A (https://www.ffpri.go.jp/qa/management/qa-manage3.html), a secondary page; the text of the 林道規程 was not checked

unchecked.item: Q59 荷と荷台の床のあいだの摩擦係数 (止まっているときの値)
unchecked.source: assumption: the container and road rule borrowed. CTU Code (MSC.1/Circ.1497) Annex 7, 2.2.2.3 and the note of Appendix 2: a material pair not in the table or not verified, max 0.3; frost, ice, snow 0.2; oily or greasy 0.1, read 2026-11-06 (p. 95-96, p. 129). Pairs in Appendix 2 (p. 128-129, read 2026-11-06): sawn timber vs plywood 0.45, plastic pallet vs stainless steel 0.15, rubber vs other materials 0.6, and others listed in .notes/R3-sources.md. The same table is quoted from EN 12195-1:2010 Annex B in the EU Best Practice Guidelines (2014) Appendix 3, read 2026-11-06 (secondary). Values for swept clean surfaces, static friction

summary: v5 (型が無いので write_design で書いた設計。v1 の系の点検 SY-01・SY-03・SY-08・SY-09 の当たりを v2〜v5 で直し、v5 の rule_check の当たりは 0)。組み立て: OK (ver-0011〜ver-0014)。音振: OK (ver-0016)。強度信頼性: R8-free OK (ver-0015)、R8-stress OK (ver-0017)、R1-step12.7 OK (ver-0018、不一致 cmp-0028 は安全側 cause-0006)。R2・R3・R6 は未判定。操安: S2-speed1.2mps OK (ver-0019)。S1・S4 は HK5 に止められて未判定、S6 は判定なし。動力: P1 は基準が無く判定なし、P4 は不一致 cmp-0027 の原因 cause-0005 が解けず未判定、P2・P3 は未判定。熱: T1・T2 の 3 つは予想通り (cmp-0019・cmp-0024・cmp-0025) だが、荷重条件に基準が無く判定なし。液体のこぼれ: F3 は不一致 cmp-0032 (cause-0007) で未判定。解析 ana-0024 は限度を超えている。人との接触: C2 は不一致 cmp-0035 (cause-0009) で未判定。解析 ana-0028 は限度を大きく超えている。
